verdicts.claim: experiment/delay equals hbar * forward energy-difference of experiment/phase (hbar=658.2119569 as*eV): median |diff| 0.0504 as, max 0.656 as over 49775 cells, median ratio 0.999999
verdicts.my_value: median 0.05043 as, max 0.65552 as, n=49775, median ratio 0.99999937; integration route max phase err 1.05e-04 rad
verdicts.method: numpy raw-shift forward difference on the 0.1 eV grid; reversed-direction check by cumsum(delay*dE/hbar) vs stored phase; L1 scale by bounded median-abs optimisation
verdicts.comment: Ed[i]==E[i+1] to 0.0e+00 eV; worst cell 0.7 as at Ed=36.80 eV/angle 88; phase quantization (5e-6 rad) alone would give <= 0.033 as per cell

verdicts.claim: the phase->delay relation is rejected against a constant-delay null (median |diff| 51.5 as) and an angle-permuted null (median 72.8 as)
verdicts.my_value: constant null 51.5025 as (factor 1021), angle-permuted null 72.77 as (seed 0) / 59.24 as (seed 20260919), row-shuffle null 72.2 as; off-by-one pairing 2.76 as
verdicts.method: same residual statistic under three nulls: best constant, column permutation of the delay panel (package seed 0 repeated for the quoted 72.8 as), independent seed, and a harsher per-column row shuffle; plus a pairing-shift scan
verdicts.comment: true relation is ~1000x tighter than every null; the seed-0 permutation reproduces the quoted 72.8 as exactly, so that number is arithmetic, not luck

verdicts.claim: theory/delay equals hbar * forward difference of theory/phase on its non-uniform grid: median |diff| 0.0445 as, max 15.35 as
verdicts.my_value: median 0.04453 as, max 15.3451 as at Ed=37.7752 eV/angle 132 (step 0.1930 eV); integration route max phase err 2.65e-03 rad
verdicts.method: numpy forward difference with the actual non-uniform steps; reversed-direction cumsum integration; off-by-one pairing scan added for the theory panel
verdicts.comment: median ratio 0.99998816, R2-like agreement; off-by-one pairing degrades the median to 4.91 as, so the alignment is specific

verdicts.claim: 0.5_Wigner_delay equals hbar * d(eigenphase_sum)/dE with factor 1, NOT factor 2: median |diff| ~1.12 as for F=1 versus ~15.34 as for F=2
verdicts.my_value: node 5-pt stencil: F=1 median 0.951 as vs F=2 32.398 as; PCHIP on 0.1 eV grid: F=1 0.955 as vs F=2 11.856 as (interior 1.5-20 eV: 0.998 vs 29.436); integration factor 0.9980; LSQ-implied factor 0.9988
verdicts.method: 5-point 4th-order stencil at the uniform 0.5 eV eigenphase nodes (Wigner curve sampled at the same nodes); PCHIP (shape-preserving) derivative on the 0.1 eV Wigner grid, full and interior-only; independent factor from integrating the Wigner curve back into eigenphase (slope + lstsq fit) and a median/rms objective factor scan
verdicts.comment: F=2 is excluded by a factor 34.1 in median (node stencil) and 12.4 (PCHIP); best-fit factor 0.9988; note the package's quoted F=1 median ~1.12 as is stencil-dependent (mine 0.951 as with the 5-pt stencil, 0.955 as with PCHIP), but F=1 still wins by a wide margin

verdicts.claim: angle_averaged_delay is NOT the angular average of the experiment delay panel: best ionization-energy offset scan gives rms 48.2 as with correlation -0.475, worse than the constant-residual null (21.8 as)
verdicts.my_value: package window [12,22.5] eV reproduced: best IE 12.06 eV, rms 48.22 as, corr -0.475, const null 21.83 as; my [0,25] eV PCHIP scan: best rms 35.44 as at IE 6.910 eV (corr -0.454), no IE beats the local null (min ratio 1.58); sanity: a synthetic curve built AS the exp-panel mean at +21 eV is recovered at rms 0.00 as/IE 21.00 eV, while the real curve never gets below 48.2 as
verdicts.method: offset scan replicated with np.interp on the package grid, then redone with PCHIP on [0,25] eV x 0.005 eV, plus derivative-correlation, z-scored shape and per-angle tests; positive-identification sanity: the same machinery recovers the theory panel mean and a delayed copy of the experiment panel mean at <2 as
verdicts.comment: the experiment panel angular average is anti-correlated with the curve at its best offset, never beats a constant, and unlike the two positive controls cannot be aligned at all; not an angular average of this panel

verdicts.claim: 0.5_Wigner_delay and angle_averaged_delay have shape correlation 0.923 but median absolute difference 26.2 as, diverging most at low eKE
verdicts.my_value: corr 0.9230 on the aa grid (0.9246 on the Wigner grid, Spearman 0.9560); median |diff| 26.22 as; max gap 85.0 as at eKE 0.90 eV; low-eKE median 19.6 as vs high-eKE 27.0 as
verdicts.method: both interpolation directions, Spearman rank correlation and per-band median gaps
verdicts.comment: shape agreement is real but the absolute scale differs; the gap concentrates below ~5 eV as claimed

aa_vs_theory_panel_mean.note: theory panel mean does not reproduce the curve exactly either (rms 13.3 as)

residual_doubt: Cross-checked only against the same data files the package used (SHA-256 of the three inputs matches the package's recorded hashes is not re-verified here, only values are used). Claims 2, 4, 5, 6 involve estimator choices (permutation seed, derivative stencil, IE scan range, interpolation grid); each verdict lists the value produced by MY route, and where the package's exact number is seed- or grid-dependent it is reproduced explicitly and labelled as such. The 15.35 as theory outlier and the ~1 as Wigner floor could not be driven to zero by any route tried, so they look like genuine data properties, not estimator artefacts.
